verdict.rationale: Codex CLI docs explicitly mention packaging repeatable instructions as 'skills' and adding plugins to connect Codex to team tools, plus MCP server support for extending tool access, directly supporting custom skill equipping. However, there's no detailed documentation on skill creation/authoring format, a skills marketplace/registry, or independent hands-on validation of the skills feature itself. missing for 10: dedicated skills authoring guide/format spec, examples of custom skills in use, independent/community corroboration of the skills feature working as described, and details on skill discovery/sharing across teams.
